It hands the cancellation rule to the domain entity (order.cancel) and stock release to the domain StockAllocationService. It saves through the repository interfaces declared in the domain layer, gets the time from an injected Clock port, and maps the result to an application DTO. The file holds no business rules of its own: it makes no state checks, does no stock arithmetic and has no conditional logic. It also has no persistence code, transport handling or framework annotations. Creating StockAllocationService directly is a wiring choice, not a responsibility from another layer.
